# Generated by tools/generate_intscore_cached_gui.cjs.
# ROOT is the viewer. All variable/flag writes belong exclusively to ROOT.
# Read existing intscore_rank_1..40; never rebuild ranking or change global targets.

gecko_intscore_gui_open = {
	set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_page value = 1 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_open
}

gecko_intscore_gui_read_slot = {
	clr_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_selected
	set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_position value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = intscore_rank_$INDEX$_exists
			has_saved_global_event_target = intscore_rank_$INDEX$
		}
		change_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_count value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_position which = gecko_intscore_gui_count }
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:intscore_rank_$INDEX$ = { tag = ROOT } }
			set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_position value = $INDEX$ }
		}
	}
}

# Candidate/current-best country scopes are read-only. The temporary event target
# belongs to this effect execution, is never global, and is not used by the GUI.
# Equal annual gains use total IntScore; exact ties retain authoritative slot order.
gecko_intscore_gui_consider_cached_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = intscore_rank_$INDEX$_exists
			has_saved_global_event_target = intscore_rank_$INDEX$
			NOT = { has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_selected }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_best_slot value = 0 } }
			set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_best_slot value = $INDEX$ }
			event_target:intscore_rank_$INDEX$ = { save_event_target_as = gecko_intscore_gui_best }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:intscore_rank_$INDEX$ = {
					event_target:gecko_intscore_gui_best = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { check_variable = { which = YearlyIntScore which = PREV } }
							AND = {
								is_variable_equal = { which = YearlyIntScore which = PREV }
								NOT = { check_variable = { which = IntScore which = PREV } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_best_slot value = $INDEX$ }
			event_target:intscore_rank_$INDEX$ = { save_event_target_as = gecko_intscore_gui_best }
		}
	}
}

gecko_intscore_gui_assign_cached_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_best_slot value = $INDEX$ } }
		set_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_selected
		set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_position which = gecko_intscore_gui_cursor }
	}
}

gecko_intscore_gui_match_cached_row = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = intscore_rank_$INDEX$_exists
			has_saved_global_event_target = intscore_rank_$INDEX$
			is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_$INDEX$_position which = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_rank }
		}
		set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_slot value = $INDEX$ }
		set_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_valid
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:intscore_rank_$INDEX$ = { tag = ROOT } }
			set_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_self
		}
	}
}

gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = {
	clr_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_valid
	clr_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_self
	set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_slot value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_rank which = gecko_intscore_gui_offset }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_row_$SLOT$_rank value = $SLOT$ }
	gecko_intscore_gui_match_cached_row = { INDEX = 1 SLOT = $SLOT$ }
	gecko_intscore_gui_match_cached_row = { INDEX = 2 SLOT = $SLOT$ }
	gecko_intscore_gui_match_cached_row = { INDEX = 3 SLOT = $SLOT$ }
	gecko_intscore_gui_match_cached_row = { INDEX = 4 SLOT = $SLOT$ }

gecko_intscore_gui_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_valid }
				1 = { NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = intscore_cache_version which = ROOT } } }
				AND = { has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_sort_annual NOT = { has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cached_sort_annual } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_sort_annual } has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cached_sort_annual }
			}
		}
		gecko_intscore_gui_build = yes
		set_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cache_valid
		clr_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cached_sort_annual
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_sort_annual }
			set_country_flag = gecko_intscore_gui_cached_sort_annual
		}
		1 = { ROOT = { set_variable = { which = intscore_cache_version which = PREV } } }
	}
	set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages which = gecko_intscore_gui_count }
	divide_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages value = 10 }
	round_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages value = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_page value = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_page value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_page which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages } }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_page which = gecko_intscore_gui_pages }
	}
	set_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_offset which = gecko_intscore_gui_page }
	subtract_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_offset value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_intscore_gui_offset value = 10 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 1 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 2 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 3 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 4 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 5 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 6 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 7 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 8 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 9 }
	gecko_intscore_gui_fill_row = { SLOT = 10 }
}
